remarks:
Seller willing to consider offers between $199,900 and $249,900.

Waterfront! Double lot! Four porches! Sunsets over the Niagara River!

Very large home in the heart of Riverside, quality of life at its finest. Water view property with stunning sunsets over the Niagara River and Strawberry Island, surrounded by parks.

Double lot with grass and an extra concrete driveway. Fenced. Gated. Landscaped with roses, flowers and berries throughout. Attached garage.

Four porches total! Two wraparound porches on the first and second floors. Two back porches, one enclosed, one open.

Traditional first floor featuring bamboo and slate flooring, a beautiful remote control gas fireplace and ceiling fan in a 20x20 family room. Surrounded by a spacious bathroom, two large bedrooms and a dining room. Kitchen and first floor laundry in the back.

The second floor is more of a loft. Front windows overlooking the Niagara River. Two bedrooms, kitchen, dining area, two porches, bathroom and second floor laundry room in the back. Jacuzzi tub, full vanity area and walk in closet.

Mechanicals? Handled. New furnace, currently heating the first floor and capable of both. One new hot water tank, currently serving one floor, second tank required for heavy usage. Two electric meters. Two gas intakes and meters, though the home has run off one for decades. Double insulation with thick board wrap and blown in. Solid roof with new wood and high wind shingles. Clean, dry and spacious basement and third floor.

Waterfront. In Buffalo. Under the radar. Not for long!
